_comment: Stryker mutation testing — flips operators / removes branches in src and reruns the suite to see which mutants the tests CATCH. A surviving mutant = a test that covers the line but asserts nothing that would notice the change (the 'shitty test' signal coverage can't detect). SCHEDULED: this is a skeleton — it cannot run until Phase 4+ when there is code, a `vitest.config.ts` (Phase 0.3), a root aggregating `tsconfig.json`, and the target modules below exist. The mutate list is forward-looking to orbweaver's planned structure; calibrate it (and the gate's break threshold) when those modules land. See docs/architecture/spine/testing.md › Mutation testing + reports/ENFORCEMENT.md.
_plugins_comment: Explicit plugin paths — pnpm's strict node_modules layout breaks Stryker's auto-discovery ('Cannot find Checker plugin typescript' even though it's installed).
_tsconfig_comment: Needs a root aggregating tsconfig.json (created alongside vitest.config.ts when the test projects land). orbweaver has only tsconfig.base.json + per-package configs today.
_mutate_comment: Default scope = the high-stakes pure modules (orbweaver targets; these files do not exist yet — Phase 4c/5). Broaden on the CLI, e.g. `pnpm test:mutation --mutate 'packages/server/src/domain/chat/**/*.ts'`.
_ignore_comment: ignorePatterns prune the sandbox copy — without this Stryker tries to copy node_modules (huge), .stryker-tmp (recursive!), reports/, coverage/, etc. Keep packages/ + tests/ + the configs.
_dashboard_comment: Dashboard reporter (mutation-score badge) is opt-in: add 'dashboard' to reporters + STRYKER_DASHBOARD_API_KEY when there's a public repo.
